onboarding.penNameWelcome: Welcome to {{appName}}! Set your pen name before you start creating.
onboarding.welcomeDescription: Your pen name is ready. Here are a few features you may want to know about:

project.title: Create a project
project.description: A project is the home for your stories, lore, characters, and other creative material.

editor.title: WYSIWYG editor
editor.description: Use headings, quotes, lists, tables, dividers, footnotes, private notes, and text colors as you type.

assets.title: Asset library
assets.description: Upload images to your library and insert them into stories or lore whenever you need them.

agent.title: AI Agent (optional)
agent.description: Bring your own model API key and configure an Agent to rewrite or continue your story.

mcp.title: MCP connection (optional)
mcp.description: Let Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI tools read and write your stories and lore through MCP—without copying and pasting.

memory.title: Shuoshuo's Memory
memory.description: Save style preferences, writing rules, and confirmed plot points. Every connected AI reads them before writing, even when you switch tools.

history.title: Version history and bookmarks
history.description: Every save creates a version you can restore. Readers can also bookmark favorite passages.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Make a project public, unlisted, or private—you decide who can see it.

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.usage: Rewrites the selection or paragraph in a different way while keeping the tone and style.

expand.label: Expand
expand.usage: Builds on the existing content with more detail and length without changing its direction.

translate.label: Translate
translate.usage: Translates into the language you specify; defaults to Traditional Chinese when none is given.

continue.label: Continue
continue.usage: Keeps writing from where the content ends without repeating what's already there.

custom.label: Custom
custom.usage: No fixed mode — follows whatever instruction you type.

shorten.label: Shorten
shorten.prompt: Please shorten this while keeping the essential information.

reference.title: Commands & references
reference.commandsDescription: Only the first command is parsed; any later / is treated as plain text. With no command and no /Agent name, it's a plain Q&A with no persona applied.
reference.skillsTitle: Single-turn skills (this message only, no Agent persona)
reference.skillsFormat: The format is /command [extra request]; the brackets mean it's optional. For example, send /rewrite alone to use the default rewrite rules, or add details like /rewrite make this passage steamier.
reference.agentsTitle: /<Agent name> — switch persona (applies to this message only; you can also insert it from the Agent menu above instead of typing)
reference.noAgents: This project doesn't have any Agents yet.
reference.emptyPrompt: (This Agent has no persona prompt yet)
reference.referencesDescription: When sent, reference tags expand into the matching story or lore content so the model can answer with context.
